zh.title: Hindsight 记忆
zh.description: 决定 DSH 何时使用长期记忆，不改动已有记忆内容。
zh.globalTitle: 在 DSH 中使用记忆
zh.globalHint: 关闭后，重启 DSH 将停止 Hindsight 自动注入、采集和会话回写。不影响其它接入工具。
zh.repositoryHint: 按记忆库（bank）设置，影响使用同一配置与 bank 的所有接入工具。多个仓库也可能共享一个 bank。
zh.emptyWorkspaces: 暂无已登记工作区。请先在 DSH 中添加工作区；总开关仍可使用。
zh.policyHint: 允许使用不会绕过 DSH 总开关或仅限已授权项目的 opt-in 策略。
zh.notOptedIn: 此项目未被 opt-in 策略授权
zh.repositoryDisabled: 仓库或目录策略已禁用记忆
zh.sharedConsent: 我确认此仓库策略也影响使用同一 bank 的其它接入工具。
zh.restartHint: 刷新页面或新建会话不能可靠刷新已缓存的配置。请在空闲时重启 DSH 服务；若不希望旧记忆留在上下文中，再新建会话。
zh.pendingTitle: 配置已保存，等待你重启 DSH
zh.runtimeUnknown: 运行时生效状态无法直接读取；下方开关表示保存的配置，不是运行中状态。
zh.dirty: 有未保存更改；离开此页会放弃草稿。
zh.saved: 已保存。重启 DSH 后生效。
zh.toolsPresent: 检测到 Hindsight 工具注册（不代表记忆正在运行）
zh.toolsAbsent: 未检测到 Hindsight 工具注册。本插件不会安装或启动 Hindsight。
zh.missingConfig: 配置文件尚不存在；保存时创建。
zh.privacyTitle: 关闭后，历史记忆会删除吗？
zh.privacyHint: 不会。此插件只修改开关，不连接 Hindsight 服务器，不读取、上传或删除记忆。已经写入服务端的记忆及后台任务需在 Hindsight 中管理。
zh.overridden: 此 bank 被 harnesses.dsh.banks 覆盖。为避免修改无效或影响其它工具，此处只读；请在配置文件中调整覆盖项。
zh.error.conflict: 配置已被其它窗口或程序修改。请重新读取后再操作，尚未覆盖外部修改。
zh.error.configBusy: 配置正在被其它进程保存。如果持续出现，请检查诊断路径旁的 .dsh-hindsight-settings.lock；确认没有保存进程后再手动处理。
zh.error.invalidConfig: 配置不是有效的 JSON 对象或相关字段类型错误。请修复配置文件后重试；原文件未被覆盖。
zh.error.unsafeConfig: 配置路径不是普通文件（可能是符号链接）。请让 HINDSIGHT_CONFIG 指向实际文件后重启 DSH。
zh.error.configTooLarge: 配置超过 1 MiB，无法安全编辑。
zh.error.readFailed: 无法读取配置，请检查路径及文件权限。
zh.error.writeFailed: 无法保存配置，请检查磁盘空间及目录权限后重新读取。
zh.error.repositoryUnavailable: 无法可靠识别此仓库，仓库设置暂不可编辑。请检查目录和 .git；总开关仍可使用。
zh.error.workspaceMissing: 工作区已不存在，请重新读取列表。
zh.error.invalidBank: 无法解析有效的记忆库名称，请检查 bank 配置。
zh.error.repositoryOverridden: 仓库策略被 DSH 专属配置覆盖，未修改。
zh.error.confirmShared: 请确认仓库策略的跨工具影响。
zh.error.badRequest: 请求无效，请重新读取后重试。
zh.error.forbidden: 此操作仅允许已登录的 DSH 所有者。
zh.error.closing: 插件正在停止，请稍后重试。
zh.error.internalError: 操作失败，请重新读取后重试。
zh.error.network: 无法连接 DSH，请检查连接后重试。
zh.error.savedRefreshFailed: 配置已保存，但状态刷新失败。请重新读取；不要重复保存。

en.title: Hindsight memory
en.description: Choose when DSH uses long-term memory without changing existing memories.
en.globalHint: Turning this off stops Hindsight injection, ingestion and session retention after restarting DSH. Other harnesses are unaffected.
en.repositoryHint: Applies to every harness using the same configuration and memory bank. Multiple repositories may share a bank.
en.emptyWorkspaces: No registered workspaces. Add one in DSH first; the DSH switch is still available.
en.policyHint: Allowing memory does not bypass the DSH switch or opt-in project policy.
en.repositoryDisabled: Repository or directory policy blocks memory
en.sharedConsent: I understand this repository policy also affects other harnesses using this bank.
en.restartHint: Refreshing the page or creating a session does not reliably reload cached configuration. Restart the DSH service when idle, then start a new session if you want old memories out of context.
en.pendingTitle: Saved; waiting for you to restart DSH
en.runtimeUnknown: Live memory state is not directly available. These controls show saved configuration, not running state.
en.dirty: Unsaved changes. Leaving this page discards the draft.
en.toolsPresent: Hindsight tools are registered (this does not prove memory is running)
en.toolsAbsent: No Hindsight tool registration detected. This plugin does not install or start Hindsight.
en.missingConfig: Configuration file does not exist yet; saving creates it.
en.privacyTitle: Does turning memory off delete history?
en.privacyHint: No. This plugin only edits switches. It does not contact the Hindsight server or read, upload or delete memories. Manage existing server memories and background tasks in Hindsight.
en.overridden: harnesses.dsh.banks overrides this bank. Editing is disabled to avoid ineffective or cross-harness changes. Adjust that override in the configuration file.
en.error.conflict: Configuration changed in another window or program. Reload before saving; external changes were not overwritten.
en.error.configBusy: Another process is saving. If this persists, check the .dsh-hindsight-settings.lock beside the configuration; remove it manually only after confirming no writer is active.
en.error.invalidConfig: Configuration is not a valid JSON object or related fields have invalid types. Fix the file and retry; it was not overwritten.
en.error.unsafeConfig: Configuration is not a regular file (it may be a symlink). Point HINDSIGHT_CONFIG at the actual file and restart DSH.
en.error.configTooLarge: Configuration exceeds the 1 MiB editing limit.
en.error.readFailed: Cannot read configuration. Check its path and permissions.
en.error.writeFailed: Cannot save configuration. Check disk space and directory permissions, then reload.
en.error.repositoryUnavailable: Cannot reliably identify this repository. Check its directory and .git; the DSH switch is still available.
en.error.workspaceMissing: Workspace no longer exists. Reload the list.
en.error.invalidBank: Cannot resolve a valid memory bank. Check bank configuration.
en.error.repositoryOverridden: DSH-specific configuration overrides this repository; nothing changed.
en.error.confirmShared: Confirm the repository policy's effect on other harnesses.
en.error.forbidden: Only the authenticated DSH owner can perform this operation.
en.error.closing: Plugin is stopping. Try again later.
en.error.network: Cannot connect to DSH. Check the connection and retry.
en.error.savedRefreshFailed: Configuration was saved, but status could not refresh. Reload instead of saving again.
